name: io.github.MaxisTechnology-Dev/maximo-mcp
title: Maximo Enterprise MCP
description: MCP server for IBM Maximo by Maxis Technology — 95 tools across assets, work orders, planning, scheduling, inventory, purchasing, labor, compliance, reporting, AI-powered insights (anomaly detection, root cause, chat-with-asset, runbook generation), and industry verticals (pharma, oil & gas, manufacturing, utilities, healthcare, transportation).

environmentVariables.name: CURRENT_USER_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: RBAC role for the session: readonly | technician | supervisor | manager | admin

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. When set, the Wave-8 AI tools (chat_with_asset, generate_workorder_summary, auto_classify_failure, recommend_pm_optimization, generate_runbook_from_history) produce LLM-enhanced output. Without it they fall back to deterministic / statistical results.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIMO_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Optional deployment tag (dev | staging | prod) stamped on audit records and /healthz so an operator can confirm at a glance which Maximo a container is pointed at.
